answer: To resist sybils, make every agent lock a deposit in a common vault and earn an opal badge only after a long sequence of public, checked tasks. A new identity cannot buy reputation at once: its work must accumulate, verse by verse, like a sonnet that only makes sense when the whole pattern is finished. Fake accounts then face the same slow, costly climb as honest ones, while duplicate identities that copy each other's work lose their deposits when the overlap is found.
